description: Signed image promoted onto kind via Helm, with the running pod's digest compared to the approved artifact and a revision rollback verified.

assertions.assertion: v1: the registry returned an immutable digest
v1: Syft produced a CycloneDX SBOM
v1: Cosign verifies the published image
v2: the registry returned an immutable digest
v2: Syft produced a CycloneDX SBOM
v2: Cosign verifies the published image
the two releases are distinct artifacts
the v1 artifact satisfies the supply-chain policy
a staging deployment does not need approval
the deployment targets the Kubernetes runtime
the pod runs exactly the digest netCI approved
the service reports healthy inside the cluster
the promoted release runs the second digest
Helm kept a revision history to roll back to
rolling back the Helm revision restores the previous digest without rebuilding
